name: Moondream Parakeet Ultra

lineage.how_derived: post-training of the same architecture, tokenizer and parameter count (card)

purpose: Better accuracy than parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 on English and the 25 European languages, in background noise and on long-form audio, at the same size and with faster inference than NeMo (card).

license.name: CC-BY-4.0
license.notes: Card states CC-BY-4.0, same as the original; no LICENSE file opened. CC-BY-4.0 requires attribution.

architecture.kind: FastConformer encoder with TDT transducer decoder plus a small voice-activity head on the encoder subsampler
architecture.why_this_design: Same architecture as parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3; the added VAD head lets the model cut long recordings at pauses into segments of at most 30 seconds, so no external VAD model is needed (card).

variants.notes: runs with the vendor's Photon runtime on NVIDIA GPU
for transcribe.cpp; Q6_K 0.61, Q5_K_M 0.55, Q4_K_M 0.49, F16 1.26 GB; ported from upstream commit 73175eb, 2.2M downloads on HF API 2026-11-19

other: transcribe.cpp (CPU, Metal, Vulkan; HIP listed in its README per the audio inbox)
engine_support.notes: transcribe.cpp card metadata: no streaming, no translation, language detection yes, token timestamps.

benchmarks.name: Open ASR Leaderboard 7 English sets, average WER
benchmarks.variant: safetensors in Photon on NVIDIA GPU (v3 baseline 6.26 in NeMo bf16)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard pipeline as of 2026-09

benchmarks.name: FLEURS German WER with MUSAN noise 0 dB
benchmarks.variant: safetensors in Photon (v3 baseline 14.45); 5 dB 6.91, 10 dB 4.98

benchmarks.name: FLEURS German WER
benchmarks.harness: third-party port, own normalization, validated against the Photon reference

benchmarks.name: RTF-style speed on M4 Max, Metal
benchmarks.variant: GGUF in transcribe.cpp (CPU 35.03; Ryzen 4750U CPU 13.29, Vulkan 23.0)

strengths: Better than parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 on every benchmark group the builder shows
Q4_K_M of 0.49 GB loses 0.02 absolute WER on LibriSpeech in the third-party table
Built-in VAD head for long audio
weaknesses: All accuracy numbers on the original card are the builder's own run in its own runtime
Greek, Latvian, Lithuanian, Slovene remain weak (FLEURS 16 to 32% WER)
No streaming in the transcribe.cpp build
best_for: fast multilingual European transcription incl. German on any hardware class
soft.maturity: Moondream, built on the NVIDIA Parakeet line; 18k downloads for the original and 2.2M for the GGUF port on the HF API.

tona_fit.reason: 0.6B, CC-BY-4.0, German FLEURS 3.61% versus 4.13% for the v3 it improves; runs on the smallest hardware class. Same FastConformer-TDT architecture as parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (record exists), so engine work for v3 carries over. Compare against parakeet-primeline (German fine-tune) and Qwen3-ASR/Rumble on German with our own test set.
blockers: FastConformer plus TDT decoder not in Tona
Photon runtime is the vendor's reference; weights are open

sources.note: GGUF card metadata with transcribe.cpp measurements

open_questions: What post-training data and recipe were used (card refers to a blog post not read)
German accuracy on our own audio (spontaneous speech, dialects)
